slides.voice: Thirty second challenge. Which one is a non-point source of water pollution?

slides.title: Tannery drainpipe
slides.voice: One. A tannery drainpipe has one identifiable outlet. That is a point source.

slides.title: Sewage outfall
rows: Gathers waste from a whole city
Reaches the river at one place
slides.voice: Two. A city sewage outfall gathers waste from a whole city, but it still reaches the river at one place.

slides.title: Fertiliser runoff
slides.voice: Three. Fertiliser washed off farmland enters from a wide area, with no single outlet. That is the non-point source.
